# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and platform reliability**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.156 release improves rendering reliability and modernizes Apple, Uno, and Windows integration. Android texture rendering follows display refresh, Windows custom fonts release their data correctly, and Linux HarfBuzz avoids system-library conflicts. Review the Apple deployment requirements and Uno 7 migration before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple application deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15, following the final deployment-floor increase for Xcode 27. Raise application deployment targets accordingly; a native minimum does not lower any higher framework or application requirement. Existing .NET 9 targets remain available. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Migrate Uno integrations to Uno 7 and .NET 10** — Non-Windows Uno views now require Uno 7 and .NET 10. SKSwapChainPanel uses a CPU canvas, derives from Grid, returns a null GRContext, and drops RaiseOnUnsupported; use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering. Windows keeps its ANGLE-backed facade. Replace pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines with the .NET SDK WebAssembly path and let Uno.Sdk supply platform native assets. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Move away from the fork-specific WinRT target** — The native fork-specific WinRT target has been retired. Move integrations using that target to a supported Windows path; desktop Windows, WinUI/Windows App SDK, and NanoServer remain supported. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))
- **Supply complete encoded text buffers** — Font text operations now reject negative byte lengths with ArgumentOutOfRangeException and odd GlyphID byte counts with ArgumentException before native interop. Pass nonnegative lengths and complete 16-bit glyph IDs. Encoded BreakText overloads return bytes; string and char-span overloads still return UTF-16 code units. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))
- **Use portable Windows runtime identifiers** — AnyCPU native-asset selection for SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp, and WinUI now uses win-x86, win-x64, and win-arm64 instead of legacy win10-* identifiers. Update projects using the old identifiers. Explicit-platform and empty-RID selection paths remain unchanged. ([#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))
- **Rebuild custom WebAssembly archives for WebGPU linking** — Newer WebAssembly consumers expect emdawnwebgpu C++ support inside libSkiaSharp.a. Use the rebuilt packaged archives or rebuild custom archives with Graphite enabled; older or GPU-disabled archives do not meet that link contract. JavaScript glue remains a link input, and the .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is unchanged. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Engine

- **Skia m156 correctness updates** — Same-milestone updates guard glyph bounds and scratch allocations, correct region storage and partial runtime-shader failures, and fix Graphite stroke bounds, paint-key comparisons, and inverse-fill clipping. SkSL rejects overflowing slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types; Ganesh GL no longer advertises GLES-invalid BGRA-as-RGBx uploads. ([#5575](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5575), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517), [#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))

## Bug Fixes

- **Display-paced Android rendering** — Automatic GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of unbounded buffer swaps. Drawing stays on the GL worker; explicit render requests and lifecycle operations remain independent of display pacing. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Reliable native boolean callbacks** — Skia callbacks use the native one-byte boolean width, including on the Mono ARM64 interpreter, while HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values. Public managed APIs and delegates continue to use bool. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Linux HarfBuzz library isolation** — Bundled HarfBuzz function calls bind locally, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from redirecting calls into an incompatible implementation. Exported entry points and managed signatures remain unchanged. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **String conversion and validation** — GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates one encoded unit: ASCII for UTF-8, one UTF-16 unit, or one UTF-32 code point. GetString reports ArgumentNullException for null byte arrays, and FromCString fixes a native buffer over-read. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **WebAssembly C source linking** — Bundling emdawnwebgpu C++ support in the native archive avoids passing C++20 compilation flags to application C sources. Its JavaScript glue remains link-only input rather than deployed application content. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Windows font and view teardown** — DWriteCore custom fonts release application data after the last dependent typeface clone is disposed. WinUI EGL teardown unbinds its own current context before destroying the surface, allowing the native window and SKGLView platform panel to be collected. ([#5577](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5577), [#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))
- **Safe Uno redraw scheduling** — Invalidate requests are deferred and coalesced to prevent synchronous PaintSurface re-entry. Redraws queued before final unload are discarded before allocating a pixel buffer; reattached controls invalidate again. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Native resource lifetime fixes** — Native cleanup retains the OpenGL module behind cached WGL pointers and corrects optional stream callbacks, XPS COM ownership, and browser capability handling. Front-buffered stream retention is also fixed. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382), [#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Lower allocation overhead** — Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation while preserving invalid-input behavior. HarfBuzzSharp pools AddUtf32 string encoding buffers, and feature-string conversion avoids a native allocation while retaining existing decoding. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Updated Windows integration dependencies** — WinUI libraries align with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 for MAUI 9 and 10, and bundled ANGLE advances to chromium/8118. These dependency updates do not raise the declared Windows runtime minimum. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))
